instruction:
GUI-only requirement: Launch Revit from the Revit shortcut on the Desktop, then complete the task entirely in the Revit graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, Dynamo, pyRevit, macros, external API automation, Python, or any helper script/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only Revit native GUI tools, menus, dialogs, schedules, sheets, and built-in export commands. Open the provided init.ifc from C:\Users\user\Desktop\init.ifc in Revit before editing, and use init_sheet.png as the local visual reference. Modify the starting model into a two-storey classroom retrofit layout with a rectangular 24.0 m by 10.0 m footprint near the project origin. The exterior wall envelope should rise about 6.6 m, include ground and upper slabs, and provide two stairs connecting the two storeys. Save the deliverables on the Desktop using the exact filenames required below.

The IFC export must use the IFC4 schema, have unique GlobalId values for all IfcRoot objects, and contain one IfcProject, one IfcSite, one IfcBuilding, two IfcBuildingStorey entities, five IfcSpace entities, eight IfcWall entities, two IfcSlab entities, and two IfcStair entities. Do not include IfcRoof, IfcDoor, IfcWindow, IfcColumn, IfcBeam, IfcCurtainWall, or IfcBuildingElementProxy entities. Name the spaces so the normalized IfcSpace names include four classrooms and one Support Room. Export a Revit room schedule named result.csv with headers Room Name,Area and exactly these rows: Classroom 1=26.0, Classroom 2=26.0, Classroom 3=26.0, Classroom 4=26.0, and Support Room=36.0. The required BIM categories must be exported as real IFC building elements/spaces, not visual-only placeholders or proxy geometry. Coordinate placement, relationship entities, GUID values, Revit type names, materials, property sets, and harmless extra metadata may vary as long as the stated model geometry, element categories, space names, schedules, sheets, and file outputs are satisfied.
